note: Safe to Feed applies to the leaves. The ears/cobs are explicitly excluded because they are too high in phosphorus and protein.

citation: The Tortoise Table — Pea (Pea Shoots, Pea Sprouts, Mangetout, Snow Pea, Snap Pea)
note: Do not Feed. The source explicitly includes pea shoots and says they are not actually toxic, but are unsuitable because of high protein and phytic-acid concerns.
Do not Feed at Artemisia genus level. Korean master is Artemisia princeps, so applicability is genus-level rather than an exact-species feeding trial.
